source_evidence: PLAYER exact instruction "Ask where these people can go for long term and how to get them home? Its obviously not our responsibility to take them, but we should know that they have a path forward to be safe." At Day285~08:31 Sedgecross wayhouse after paid three-night stay and completed Long Rest. V authorizes ASKING the wayhouse keeper, civilian sick-tender and patients about realistic options, NOT V payment, another booking, formal appointment, dispatch, patient transfer, forced testimony, official report, or V-led journey. DM independent unrolled civilian conversation ~08:40–09:00, no social DC as relevant caregivers willingly give ordinary nonsecret practical knowledge. Sick-tender honestly states P7–P9 need longer flat-transport recovery, no magical cure or fixed recovery dates, and safe home is not automatically same as recorded address. She knows of an existing civilian recovery-home contact/trustee in CAER VEYLAN (already established in DM-only preparation as uncontacted, not contracted), which may accept injured patients and help arrange sustained civilian care and family contact. No acceptance from this trustee exists; no city contact made in play, no promise it can accommodate11 or fund expenses. Keeper knows normal road carriers can convey a message toward Caer Veylan and offers to help make an inquiry, but she will not claim a reply, guaranteed free transport or indefinite lodging. Prepared trustee's possible capacity (two ordinary borrowed unarmored carts, two ordinary horses, three carers) remains UNCOMMITTED prep only; DM does not fabricate ready carts or a newly arrived convoy at Sedgecross. For safe family return, injured need flat carts and actual willing carers; ambulatory patients may travel via ordinary civilian caravan/carter only by consent and when safer routes/destination/cost are agreed. Cirren privately asks willing patients what they need, without script-choosing V actions or revealing originals. One existing ambulatory patient (keep identity as still unnamed/not overwrite KN-P1..P6 records) says they wish to reach relatives but fear traveling unaccompanied through a military checkpoint. KN-P4 who earlier established his own falsely marked discharge voices fear his family could be implicated in harboring him. KN-P7 as one of three existing nonambulatory patients wants loved ones contacted and cannot currently stand. These are newly spoken, voluntary concerns and do NOT establish exact hometown, kin name, next-of-kin address, arrest warrant or police knowledge. P10/P11 and others have not yet given explicit family-contact agreement; individual consent remains needed. Sick-tender voluntarily offers to organize medical-information referral if patients authorize it; keeper offers ordinary outgoing courier inquiry through established road service. NO message actually dispatched, fee charged, return reply or civilian transport booked in this turn. Neither V nor his companions are obligated to escort or cover future bills; the only pending V decision is whether to authorize/delegate any specific contact/funding/extension or depart after realistic transition support. Eleven patients remain at existing Sedgecross wayhouse, all alive and stable, eight ambulatory and P7–P9 flat, three PREPAID nights expired Day285 dawn. No FOURTH-night lodging/care booked/paid, no indefinite refuge guarantee or formal Kestrel operation final closure; the facility is left as last observed. V originals (two false discharge/occupancy folios, signed trial injury packet, bureau-sealed regional Kestrel authorization naming Corven Nask, EVERMARCH/CLEAR WILL original orders, original transfer/requisition ledger, mage component pouch) in V custody unchanged; Mara retains prior Neri interview notes; Fenar retains six sealed reagent vials padded case and silver-fitted precision instrument; no new evidence discovered, copying or custody transfer. V HP48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 free Psychic Whispers1/1 (not used); Fenar HP59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 MP6/6 CLIMB40; Cirren HP51/51 and full slots/CD2; Mara healthy; four owned horses/coach sound; V personal purse922gp6sp6cp, carried rations9 and horse feed12, Pixie Dust1 sealed; LongRest6/6 complete. This is information-gathering/dialogue only and time advances ~25–30min within SAME morning, no random roll required, no invisible interregnum. NEXT V choice whether simply allow sick-tender/keeper to explore referral independently, authorize sending actual message, extend funding/booking, investigate records further or depart: don't compel admin chase, don't presume the individuals will be safely housed after V leaves.
